note: The approved vendor list for this functional area. Ratings are the buyer's own scorecard, not a supplier's self-report: each is the average of four scores kept from previous business, so a buyer can see what a headline number is made of and disagree with a part of it rather than the whole.

score_names.quality: Quality — rejections, complaints, consistency of the last year's deliveries.
score_names.delivery: Delivery — how often they hit the promised date, and how they behave when they cannot.
score_names.commercial: Commercial — competitiveness at last award, and whether prices held as agreed.
score_names.responsiveness: Responsiveness — how quickly they quote, and how completely.

categories.name: Corrugated boxes and cartons
categories.covers: 3-ply, 5-ply and 7-ply shipping boxes, printed shippers, die-cut cartons.

vendors.name: Shakti Packaging Industries Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Incumbent on the 5-ply range. Slab rates on annual offtake.

vendors.name: Sri Balaji Corrugators Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Strong on heavy-duty grades. Includes delivery in their rates.

vendors.name: Meridian Packaging LLP
vendors.note: Quotes everything, fastest to respond. Discloses its own OTD misses.

vendors.name: Northstar Packaging
vendors.note: Cheapest on 3-ply, but quotes on a photographed rate card and has an ISO audit outstanding.

categories.name: Protective and void fill
categories.covers: Edge protectors, corner boards, partitions, moulded inserts, air pillows.

vendors.name: Meridian Packaging LLP
vendors.note: Also supplies partitions and edge protectors off the same line.

vendors.name: Cushionwrap Systems Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Moulded inserts and foam. Tooling charged separately — ask for it in writing.

vendors.name: Guardline Protective Packaging
vendors.note: Competitive on corner boards at volume. Longer lead time from Chennai.

categories.name: Kraft paper, rolls and sheets
categories.covers: Kraft reels, corrugated sheet board, layer pads, interleaving paper.

vendors.name: Shakti Packaging Industries Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Supplies mill rolls in 50 kg reels alongside the box range.

vendors.name: Deccan Kraft Mills Ltd
vendors.note: Mill direct, so keenest on paper price — but quotes per kg, which needs a stated GSM and reel width to compare.

vendors.name: Sri Balaji Corrugators Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Sheet board in standard sizes; converts its own reels.

categories.name: Tapes, labels and consumables
categories.covers: BOPP and paper tape, strapping, stretch film, shipping labels, ribbons.

vendors.name: Pacific Pack Global Pvt Ltd
vendors.note: Export-oriented unit; quotes FOB in USD, so every price needs converting and the freight is on top.

vendors.name: Trueline Labels and Tapes
vendors.note: Local, quick, reliable on repeat consumables. Small MOQs.

vendors.name: Vector Film and Strapping Co
vendors.note: Stretch film and strapping at volume; rates move with the resin market, so ask what the quote is pegged to.
